📺 Party of Five (1994–2000)

Party of Five follows the five Salinger siblings—Charlie, Bailey, Julia, Claudia, and Owen—whose lives change dramatically after their parents die in a car accident. Forced to navigate life without parental guidance, the siblings struggle to keep their family together while facing financial difficulties, personal challenges, and complicated relationships. As the oldest sibling, Charlie takes on the responsibility of raising his younger brothers and sisters while managing the family restaurant and pursuing his own dreams. Meanwhile, Bailey, Julia, and Claudia experience the emotional challenges of growing up under extraordinary circumstances. Starring Matthew Fox, Scott Wolf, Neve Campbell, and Lacey Chabert, the series delivers powerful performances and heartfelt storytelling while exploring grief, family bonds, love, responsibility, resilience, and the importance of supporting one another through life’s most difficult moments.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family • Teen Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 44 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creators: Christopher Keyser & Amy Lippman

📺 Seasons: 6 • 142 Episodes

📍 Setting: San Francisco, California.

🏆 Awards: Golden Globe Award for Best Television Series – Drama.
